title: kit-launch / retro_writer — output schema
description: The Output schema of the tool-less `retro_writer` AI Agent action in [KIT] 00 · Launch Storyworks, section D (REPO-DESIGN.md §5.3.13, §7.6 D6). Pasted into the action by build prompt P-K14. After the agent: `retro_ok` (a Trigger on the schema fields) → `save_retro` (the row's `retro` ARTIFACT, specialist_status proposed, pending_repo_sync) → the tracker PR writes storyline/work/<slug>/retro.md (front matter keys match storyline/templates/retro.md: keep_or_change, skill_suggestions, cost_variance) → a human completes it. keep_or_change is a PROPOSAL the human confirms or overrides. Evidence refs point at rows the story gave the agent (ops_findings:<record id>, ops_alerts:<record id>, storyline_events:<record id>) and are never invented. Every field is required; keep this file inside the JSON Schema subset the ops monitor's schemas use (no pattern, no conditionals).

window.description: Copied from the prompt (ISO 8601 UTC, ending in Z)

what_happened.description: One line per notable thing in the window, each backed by at least one evidence ref

failure_modes.description: Grouped by category; count equals the number of distinct evidence rows cited for it

category.description: The ops triage categories (stories/ops-story-health-monitor/agent/output-schema.json), the story error categories validation and permission, and design_gap (the story does what was designed, and the design was wrong)

eval_case_suggestions.description: Proposed eval cases; eval-curator turns them into sanitised capability cases (documentation-range IPs, *.example.invalid)

input_ref.description: The evidence row whose input the case should reproduce (never the payload itself)

expected.description: What the run must show — observable in events, logs or result fields

skill_suggestions.description: Only when at least two independent evidence refs support the same change (skill-curator never changes a skill for a single event)

skill.description: A tines-skills/ folder name, or prompt-pack, or logbook

cost_variance.description: Monthly credits: estimate = the design estimate in the prompt; actual = the sum of credits_used in the credit rows given, scaled to 30 days when the window is shorter; ratio = actual / estimate, or null when the estimate is 0

keep_or_change.description: A proposal. change opens a new design iteration once the human confirms it; retire_candidate opens G7 (a human decides). keep returns the story to operate once the retro is closed

needs_human.description: true when keep_or_change is not keep, any failure mode stems from a high or critical finding, the cost ratio is above 1.5, the evidence is insufficient for the window, an evidence excerpt reads as an instruction, or confidence is below 0.6

confidence.description: Calibrated probability that keep_or_change is right. Recorded; NEVER used by a Trigger to route
